chunks: What al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Ṣafwān, from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

The people hold Jumuʿah on Friday when they are five or more. If they are fewer than five, then there is no Jumuʿah for them. Jumuʿah is obligatory upon every person; the people are not excused from it except five: the woman, the owned slave, the traveler, the child, and the sick person.

key_terms.خَمْسَةً: five persons, the minimum number mentioned for establishing Jumuʿah
key_terms.لَا يُعْذَرُ: are not excused, not granted exemption
key_terms.ٱلْمَرِيضُ: the sick person, one exempt from Jumuʿah
key_terms.ٱلْمُسَافِرُ: the traveler, one exempt from Jumuʿah

ai.seo_question: How many people are required for Jumuʿah, and who is excused from attending it?
ai.summary: This hadith states the minimum number required for establishing Jumuʿah and identifies those exempt from its obligation. It is a legal text in the chapter on the number of people upon whom Jumuʿah becomes obligatory, clarifying both communal threshold and recognized excuses.
